# A tree list never shows a record's selection, and drops one on render

## Context

Found while building the file explorer (#21885). A `Neo.tree.List` loses its selection on screen in two ways, while the selection model still holds it:

1. **A selection made from a record never shows.** `selectionModel.select(record)` resolves the record to `<treeId>__<internal id>` (`neo-record-N`), but the tree renders `<treeId>__<key>`. The model holds an id no item has, so nothing is annotated. The Portal's learn tree does exactly this for the current page (`apps/portal/view/learn/MainContainerController.mjs:102`, `src/app/content/TreeList.mjs:93`): on `dev` `3766834958`, `#/learn/gettingstarted/Workspaces` renders `neo-treelist-1__gettingstarted/Workspaces` with no `neo-selected` and no `aria-selected`, before and after a click on it.
2. **A render drops a selection.** An item selected by a click loses `neo-selected` and `aria-selected` as soon as the tree renders it again.

## The Problem

Defect 1 hides the current page in the Portal's learning section and in every content tree that selects by record. Defect 2 hits every re-render path:

- a store load: a folder's children loaded on open (`onFolderItemClick` + `store.add`), a `Neo.draggable.tree.SortZone` drop, which ends in `owner.createItems()`, and the sort zone's own creation;
- a record change: `onStoreRecordChange` renders the item again, so an in-place rename (`Neo.list.plugin.ItemEditing`) unselects it on screen.

In both, `isSelected()` and the screen disagree, and assistive technology reads no `aria-selected`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/list/Base.mjs:195` — `useInternalId: true` by default; `getRecordId()` (`:706`) then answers the store's internal id, and `getItemId(record)` builds the item id from it.
- `src/tree/List.mjs` renders every item id from the record's key (`getItemId(record[keyProperty])` in `createItem`, `getItemId(item.id)` across the class), as do `src/tree/Accordion.mjs` (`getItemId(me.store.getKey(record))`) and the other tree subclasses. No tree path uses internal ids.
- `src/list/Base.mjs:517` — `list.Base#createItem` asks `selectionModel.isSelected(itemId)` and renders the selected class and `aria-selected`. `tree.List#createItem` overrides it without `super` and never asks.
- `src/selection/Model.mjs:129` — `annotateItem()` and `deannotateItem()` own what "selected" looks like on a vdom node.
- #20350 closed the same render drift for ordinary lists and left tree lists out of scope: "buffered or tree lists, which have their own creation and identity paths".

## The Fix

In `src/tree/List.mjs`:

- `useInternalId: false`, so a record resolves to the id the tree renders.
- `createItem` hands the item to `selectionModel.annotateItem()` when the model holds it and selection is enabled (`!me.disableSelection && selectionModel?.isSelected(itemId)`), the condition `list.Base#createItem` uses.

One test in `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs` covers selecting by record, a full render, a record change and `disableSelection`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `selectionModel.select(record)` renders `neo-selected` and `aria-selected: true` on that record's item.
- [ ] `createItems()` keeps both on the selected item; other items carry neither.
- [ ] A record change (a rename) keeps both on the selected item.
- [ ] With `disableSelection: true` no item renders as selected.
- [ ] The Portal's learn tree highlights the current page on load and follows a click to another page.
- [ ] The tree, list, selection and draggable unit specs pass.

## Out of Scope

- Clearing a filter opens every folder (`tree.List#filter` with an empty value): engine behaviour, noted on #21885.
- `Neo.selection.TreeModel`'s keyboard hooks (`onNavKey`, `onKeyDownEnter` are stubs; the Navigator addon moves focus between items).
